decision: Exercise one complete, synthetic authoring-smoke lifecycle without supporting a release or approval decision.

scope.intended_use: Provider-free fixture coverage of routing, execution, evidence creation, and bounded conclusions.

unit: One isolated synthetic attempt at one declared case.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only the synthetic catalog before selection.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate only the synthetic target and declared fixture adapter.

evidence.storage: Write routine fixture evidence only to .work/evals.

grading.instrument: Deterministic fixture routing and assertion grading.
grading.unknown_policy: Missing adapter or artifact evidence remains unknown.
critical_gates: Both synthetic stages retain attributable evidence
grading.calibration: The outer suite separately checks artifact presence and missing-evidence behavior.

trials.expansion_rule: Add trials only when a synthetic mechanics conclusion is unstable.

comparison.absence: This fixture measures mechanics, not comparative value.

critical_assertions.gate: Both synthetic stages retain attributable evidence
critical_assertions.assertion: The execution response is preserved as raw evidence.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, unknowns, and harness errors separate.

estimand.uncertainty: No population inference; report the bound fixture outcomes only.

provenance.independence: Same-agent fixture evidence remains authoring smoke.

refresh_triggers: Fixture target, adapter, evaluator protocol, or evidence layout changes
